iso9001_clauses.title: Scope
iso9001_clauses.summary: This International Standard specifies requirements for a quality management system when an organization needs to demonstrate its ability to consistently provide products and services that meet customer and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements, and aims to enhance customer satisfaction through the effective application of the system, including processes for improvement and the assurance of conformity to customer and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
requirements: Specifies requirements for a quality management system
Applicable to any organization regardless of size, type, and products/services
Demonstrate ability to consistently provide conforming products/services
Aim to enhance customer satisfaction
Address risks and opportunities associated with organizational context

iso9001_clauses.title: Normative references
iso9001_clauses.summary: There are no normative references in this document.

iso9001_clauses.title: Terms and definitions
iso9001_clauses.summary: For the purposes of this document, the terms and definitions given in ISO 9000:2015 apply. Key terms include: quality, quality management system, top management, effectiveness, policy, objective, risk, competence, documented information, process, performance, outsourcing, monitoring, measurement, audit, conformity, nonconformity, corrective action, continual improvement.
requirements: Refer to ISO 9000 for complete list of terms and definitions

iso9001_clauses.title: Context of the organization
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and strategic direction and affect its ability to achieve the intended results of the QMS. It must identify interested parties, their needs and expectations, define the scope of the QMS, and establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the QMS including its processes.
requirements: Determine external and internal issues relevant to QMS
Explicitly consider climate change as a relevant external issue (integrated from 2024 amendment)
Identify interested parties and their requirements
Define the scope of the QMS considering issues and interested parties
Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve QMS
Determine processes needed for the QMS and their interactions
Define criteria and methods for process operation and control
Ensure availability of resources and information
Monitor, measure, and analyze processes
Implement actions to achieve planned results and continual improvement

iso9001_clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and its strategic direction and that affect its ability to achieve the intended result(s) of its quality management system. Organizations must explicitly consider whether climate change is a relevant issue.
requirements: Determine external issues (legal, technological, competitive, market, cultural, social, economic, environmental)
Determine internal issues (values, culture, knowledge, performance)
Explicitly determine whether climate change is a relevant issue
Monitor and review information about these issues
Consider strategic direction when analyzing context

iso9001_clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the interested parties that are relevant to the quality management system, and the requirements of these interested parties. Climate change considerations from interested parties must be considered.
requirements: Identify interested parties relevant to QMS
Determine their needs and expectations
Consider whether interested parties have climate change-related requirements
Monitor and review information about interested parties and their requirements

iso9001_clauses.title: Determining the scope of the quality management system
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the quality management system to establish its scope. The scope shall be documented and consider external/internal issues, interested party requirements, and products/services.
requirements: Consider issues from 4.1 and requirements from 4.2
Consider products and services
Define boundaries and applicability
Document the scope and make it available
Include the types of products and services covered
Provide justification for any requirement not applicable

iso9001_clauses.title: Quality management system and its processes
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve a quality management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.
requirements: Determine processes needed and their inputs/outputs
Determine sequence and interaction of processes
Determine criteria and methods for effective operation and control
Determine resources needed
Assign responsibilities and authorities
Address risks and opportunities
Evaluate processes and implement changes
Improve processes and the QMS
Maintain documented information to support process operation

iso9001_clauses.title: Leadership
iso9001_clauses.summary: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment, establish a quality policy, ensure roles, responsibilities, and authorities are assigned and communicated, and promote a quality culture and ethical behaviour throughout the organization.
requirements: Demonstrate leadership and commitment
Establish, implement, and maintain quality policy
Promote quality culture and ethical behaviour
Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities

iso9001_clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
iso9001_clauses.summary: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment by taking accountability for QMS effectiveness, ensuring policy and objectives are established, integrating QMS into business processes, promoting process approach and risk-based thinking, ensuring resources are available, communicating importance, and promoting quality culture and ethical behaviour.
requirements: Take accountability for QMS effectiveness
Ensure quality policy and objectives are established and compatible with strategic direction
Integrate QMS requirements into business processes
Promote use of process approach and risk-based thinking
Ensure resources are available
Communicate importance of effective quality management
Ensure QMS achieves intended results
Engage, direct, and support persons
Promote improvement
Support other management roles
Promote quality culture and ethical behaviour throughout organization

iso9001_clauses.title: Quality policy
iso9001_clauses.summary: Top management shall establish, implement, and maintain a quality policy that is appropriate to the purpose and context of the organization, supports its strategic direction, provides a framework for setting quality objectives, includes commitment to satisfy applicable requirements, and includes commitment to continual improvement. The policy must be documented, communicated, and available to interested parties.
requirements: Establish quality policy appropriate to purpose and context
Support strategic direction
Provide framework for setting quality objectives
Include commitment to satisfy applicable requirements
Include commitment to continual improvement
Reflect context of the organization
Be maintained as documented information
Be communicated, understood, and applied
Be available to relevant interested parties

iso9001_clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
iso9001_clauses.summary: Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned, communicated, and understood within the organization. They shall assign responsibility and authority for ensuring QMS conformity and reporting on QMS performance.
requirements: Assign responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles
Communicate responsibilities and authorities
Ensure they are understood
Assign specific responsibility for QMS conformity to requirements
Assign specific responsibility for reporting on QMS performance
Ensure integration with quality culture expectations

iso9001_clauses.title: Planning
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall take actions to address risks and opportunities, with clearer separation between risk management and opportunity pursuit. It must establish quality objectives and plan changes to the QMS with expanded requirements for monitoring and evaluating change effectiveness.
requirements: Address risks and opportunities with separate consideration
Establish quality objectives
Plan changes with enhanced monitoring requirements

iso9001_clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
iso9001_clauses.summary: When planning, the organization shall consider issues from 4.1 and requirements from 4.2, and determine risks and opportunities that need to be addressed. The requirements for risks and opportunities are now clearly separated into subclauses.
requirements: Establish processes to determine risks and opportunities
Consider organizational context and interested party requirements
Separately identify risks that could affect QMS outcomes
Separately identify opportunities for enhancement and improvement

iso9001_clauses.title: Determination of risks and opportunities
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to give assurance that the QMS can achieve its intended result(s), enhance desirable effects, prevent or reduce undesired effects, and achieve improvement.
requirements: Determine risks affecting QMS ability to achieve intended results
Determine opportunities to enhance desirable effects
Consider risks that could prevent or reduce undesired effects
Identify opportunities for improvement
Document risks and opportunities as appropriate

iso9001_clauses.title: Planning actions to address risks
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall plan actions to address risks. These actions shall be proportionate to the potential impact on conformity of products and services and customer satisfaction.
requirements: Plan actions to address identified risks
Ensure actions are proportionate to potential impact
Integrate actions into QMS processes
Evaluate effectiveness of actions

iso9001_clauses.title: Planning actions to address opportunities
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall plan actions to address opportunities. Opportunities can lead to the adoption of new practices, launching new products, opening new markets, addressing new customers, building partnerships, using new technology, and other desirable possibilities to address organizational needs.
requirements: Plan actions to address identified opportunities
Consider adoption of new practices and technologies
Explore new markets and customer segments
Build partnerships and collaborations
Integrate opportunity actions into QMS processes
Evaluate effectiveness of actions

iso9001_clauses.title: Quality objectives and planning to achieve them
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish quality objectives at relevant functions, levels, and processes. Objectives must be consistent with quality policy, measurable, monitored, communicated, and updated. Plans for achieving them shall determine what, resources, responsible, when, and how results will be evaluated.
requirements: Establish quality objectives for relevant functions, levels, and processes
Ensure objectives are consistent with quality policy
Make objectives measurable
Take into account applicable requirements
Be relevant to conformity and customer satisfaction
Monitor objectives
Communicate objectives
Update objectives as appropriate
Maintain documented information on objectives
Determine what will be done
Determine resources required
Assign responsibility
Set completion time
Define how results will be evaluated

iso9001_clauses.title: Planning of changes
iso9001_clauses.summary: When changes to the QMS are needed, they shall be carried out in a planned manner. The organization shall consider the purpose of changes and potential consequences, integrity of QMS, availability of resources, allocation of responsibilities, and monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of changes.
requirements: Carry out changes in a planned manner
Consider purpose of changes and potential consequences
Maintain integrity of QMS
Ensure resources are available
Allocate or reallocate responsibilities and authorities
Monitor and evaluate effectiveness of changes
Communicate changes to relevant parties
Review results of changes

iso9001_clauses.title: Support
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine and provide resources needed for the QMS, ensure people are competent, establish awareness including quality culture, determine communication including digital channels, and control documented information.
requirements: Provide resources
Ensure competence
Establish awareness including quality culture
Determine communication including digital channels
Control documented information

iso9001_clauses.title: Resources
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the QMS, including people, infrastructure, environment for operation, monitoring and measuring resources, and organizational knowledge. The standard recognizes digital forms of work and information communication technology as part of infrastructure.
requirements: Determine and provide resources for QMS
Consider capabilities and constraints of existing internal resources
Consider what to obtain from external providers
Provide infrastructure (buildings, equipment, utilities, IT, digital systems)
Recognize digital forms of work (on-site, remote, hybrid)
Provide environment for operation (social, psychological, physical)
Ensure monitoring and measuring resources are suitable and calibrated/verified
Maintain organizational knowledge and make it available as necessary
Ensure knowledge is accessible in digital formats where applicable

iso9001_clauses.title: Monitoring and measuring resources
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall ensure monitoring and measurement results are valid by providing resources suitable for the specific type of monitoring and measurement activities, and maintaining them to ensure continued fitness for purpose.
requirements: Determine resources needed for valid monitoring and measurement
Ensure resources are suitable for specific activities
Maintain resources to ensure continued fitness
Retain documented information as evidence of fitness for purpose
Calibrate/verify measuring instruments at specified intervals or before use
Identify calibration status
Safeguard from adjustments, damage, or deterioration
Protect digital monitoring and measurement data integrity

iso9001_clauses.title: Competence
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the necessary competence of persons doing work under its control that affects the performance and effectiveness of the QMS, ensure these persons are competent on the basis of appropriate education, training, or experience, take actions to acquire necessary competence, evaluate effectiveness of actions, and retain documented information.
requirements: Determine necessary competence of persons affecting QMS performance
Ensure persons are competent based on education, training, or experience
Take actions to acquire necessary competence
Evaluate effectiveness of actions taken
Retain documented information as evidence of competence

iso9001_clauses.title: Awareness
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall ensure that persons doing work under its control are aware of the quality policy, relevant quality objectives, their contribution to QMS effectiveness, implications of not conforming, and the importance of quality culture and ethical behaviour.
requirements: Ensure awareness of quality policy
Ensure awareness of relevant quality objectives
Ensure awareness of their contribution to QMS effectiveness
Ensure awareness of implications of not conforming
Ensure awareness of quality culture and ethical behaviour expectations

iso9001_clauses.title: Communication
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the internal and external communications relevant to the QMS, including what, when, with whom, how, and who communicates. Communication channels include digital platforms and social media.
requirements: Determine what to communicate
Determine when to communicate
Determine with whom to communicate
Determine how to communicate including digital channels and social media
Determine who communicates

iso9001_clauses.title: Documented information
iso9001_clauses.summary: The QMS shall include documented information required by ISO 9001 and determined by the organization as necessary for effectiveness. Creation, update, and control of documented information must be managed to ensure availability, suitability, and protection, including digital documentation.

Include documented information determined necessary for QMS effectiveness
Ensure appropriate identification and description (title, date, author, reference)
Ensure appropriate format and media including digital formats
Ensure review and approval for suitability and adequacy
Control documented information to ensure availability where and when needed
Ensure adequate protection (confidentiality, improper use, integrity, loss)
Control distribution, access, retrieval, use
Control storage and preservation including digital systems
Control changes and version control
Control retention and disposition
Manage documented information of external origin
Prevent unintended use of obsolete documented information

iso9001_clauses.title: Operation
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization must plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet product and service requirements, including operational planning and control, requirements determination, design and development, control of externally provided processes, production and service provision, release, and control of nonconforming outputs.
requirements: Plan, implement, and control operational processes
Determine requirements for products and services
Establish design and development processes
Control externally provided processes
Control production and service provision
Control release of products and services
Control nonconforming outputs

iso9001_clauses.title: Operational planning and control
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall plan, implement, and control processes to meet requirements, establish criteria, control processes per criteria, maintain documented information, control planned changes, review consequences of unintended changes, and ensure outsourced processes are controlled.
requirements: Plan, implement, and control processes to meet product/service requirements
Establish criteria for processes
Control processes in accordance with criteria
Maintain documented information to have confidence processes were carried out as planned
Control planned changes and review consequences of unintended changes
Ensure outsourced processes are controlled

iso9001_clauses.title: Requirements for products and services
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish processes for communication with customers including digital channels, determine requirements for products and services, review them before commitment, and manage changes to requirements.

Include digital communication channels (web, social media, FAQs)
Determine requirements for products/services including statutory/regulatory
Review requirements before commitment to supply
Resolve contract/order differences
Confirm customer requirements before acceptance
Maintain documented information on review results
Amend relevant documents when requirements change
Ensure relevant persons are aware of changed requirements

iso9001_clauses.title: Design and development of products and services
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, and maintain a design and development process appropriate to ensure subsequent provision of products and services, including stages, controls, inputs, outputs, and change management.

Determine stages and controls (review, verification, validation)
Determine responsibilities and authorities
Determine resource needs
Manage interfaces between persons involved
Ensure customer/user involvement as necessary
Determine design and development inputs
Resolve conflicting inputs
Apply controls to ensure outputs meet input requirements
Perform reviews to evaluate ability to meet requirements
Perform verification to ensure outputs meet inputs
Perform validation to ensure products/services meet requirements
Retain documented information
Identify and control changes
Review, control, and document changes

iso9001_clauses.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall ensure externally provided processes, products, and services conform to requirements, determine controls to apply, evaluate and select external providers, define requirements, and monitor performance.

Determine controls applicable when products/services are intended for incorporation
Determine controls when provided directly to customer by external providers
Determine controls when processes are outsourced
Define criteria for evaluation, selection, monitoring, and re-evaluation
Retain documented information
Communicate requirements to external providers

iso9001_clauses.title: Production and service provision
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall implement production and service provision under controlled conditions, including documented information, monitoring and measuring, infrastructure, competent persons, validation, prevention of human error, and control of changes. Enhanced requirements for change management and business continuity.
requirements: Implement production and service provision under controlled conditions
Make available documented information defining characteristics and results
Make available documented information for monitoring and measurement
Use suitable monitoring and measuring resources
Implement monitoring and measurement activities
Use suitable infrastructure and environment including digital systems
Ensure competent persons
Validate and revalidate ability to achieve planned results
Implement actions to prevent human error
Control release, delivery, and post-delivery activities
Control and review changes with enhanced monitoring
Preserve outputs during production and service provision
Meet post-delivery activities as determined
Identify and control changes essential for conformity
Manage risks related to business continuity during disruptions

iso9001_clauses.title: Release of products and services
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall implement planned arrangements at appropriate stages to verify product and service requirements have been met. Release shall not proceed until arrangements are completed, unless approved by relevant authority and, if applicable, customer.
requirements: Implement planned arrangements to verify requirements met
Do not release until arrangements satisfactorily completed
Unless approved by relevant authority or customer
Retain documented information on release

iso9001_clauses.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall ensure outputs that do not conform to requirements are identified and controlled to prevent unintended use or delivery. Take appropriate action based on nature of nonconformity. Retain documented information.

Prevent unintended use or delivery
Take action to correct, segregate, contain, return, or suspend provision

iso9001_clauses.title: Performance evaluation
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization must monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate QMS performance, evaluate compliance, conduct internal audits, and perform management reviews with consideration of climate change and other contextual factors.
requirements: Monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate QMS performance
Evaluate compliance with obligations
Conduct internal audits
Perform management reviews including climate change considerations

iso9001_clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, methods, criteria, and when to analyze and evaluate results. It shall evaluate QMS performance and effectiveness, monitor customer satisfaction, and retain documented information.

Determine methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation

Retain documented information as evidence

iso9001_clauses.title: Internal audit
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the QMS conforms to own requirements and ISO 9001, and is effectively implemented and maintained. It shall establish audit programme, define audit criteria and scope, select auditors, and report results.

Determine if QMS conforms to organization's own requirements and ISO 9001
Determine if QMS is effectively implemented and maintained

Retain documented information

iso9001_clauses.title: Management review
iso9001_clauses.summary: Top management shall review the QMS at planned intervals to ensure continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness, and alignment with strategic direction. Review shall consider status of previous actions, changes in context including climate change, performance information, resource adequacy, risk and opportunity actions, and opportunities for improvement. Outputs shall include decisions on improvement opportunities, QMS changes, and resource needs.

Ensure continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness

Consider opportunities for improvement
Retain documented information

iso9001_clauses.title: Improvement
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine and select opportunities for improvement, react to nonconformities, take corrective action, and continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the QMS.
requirements: Determine and select opportunities for improvement
React to nonconformities and take corrective action
Continually improve QMS suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness

iso9001_clauses.title: Continual improvement
iso9001_clauses.summary: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the QMS. The organization shall consider results of analysis and evaluation, outputs from management review, and leverage emerging technologies, digitalization, and reliable data as enablers for effective improvement of processes and activities.

Consider results of analysis and evaluation
Consider outputs from management review
Leverage emerging technologies and digitalization for improvement
Use reliable data for evidence-based improvement
Improve processes, products, and services

Enhance customer satisfaction

iso9001_clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
iso9001_clauses.summary: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall react, take action to control and correct it, deal with consequences, evaluate need for action to eliminate causes, implement any action needed, review effectiveness of corrective action, update risks and opportunities, and make changes to QMS if necessary. Retain documented information.

Retain documented information
